sentences.zh: 郭璞

translations.literal: Guo Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Biography of Guo Pu.

sentences.zh: 郭璞，字景純，河東聞喜人也。

translations.literal: Guo Pu, courtesy Jingchun, was a man of Wenxi in Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu, courtesy name Jingchun, came from Wenxi in Hedong commandery.

sentences.zh: 父瑗，尚書都令史。

translations.literal: His father Guo Yuan was secretary chief clerk of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: His father, Guo Yuan, served as secretary chief clerk of the Ministry of State.

sentences.zh: 時尚書杜預有所增損，瑗多駁正之，以公方著稱。

translations.literal: When Masters of Writing Du Yu made additions and cuts, Yuan frequently refuted and corrected him and became famed for impartiality.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Du Yu revised protocols Guo Yuan corrected his slips so steadily that contemporaries praised his fairness.

sentences.zh: 終於建平太守。

translations.literal: He ended as Grand Administrator of Jianping.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office as governor of Jianping.

sentences.zh: 璞好經術，博學有高才，而訥於言論，詞賦為中興之冠。

translations.literal: Pu loved classical studies, was broadly learned with lofty talent, yet clumsy in debate; his verse ranked first among the Restoration writers.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu loved classical learning and mastered many disciplines despite awkward speech; poets ranked his fu verse foremost among the Restoration authors.

sentences.zh: 好古文奇字，妙於陰陽算曆。

translations.literal: He loved antique script and unusual graphs and excelled at yin-yang reckoning and calendars.
translations.idiomatic: He cherished archaic characters and excelled at yin-yang numerology and calendar science.

sentences.zh: 有郭公者，客居河東，精于卜筮，璞從之受業。

translations.literal: There was a Master Guo who lodged west of the river and mastered divination; Pu studied under him.
translations.idiomatic: A visitor called Master Guo practiced divination west of the river, and Guo Pu apprenticed himself to him.

sentences.zh: 公以《青囊中書》九卷與之，由是遂洞五行、天文、卜筮之術，攘災轉禍，通致無方，雖京房、管輅不能過也。

translations.literal: The elder gave him nine fascicles of The Satchel of Azure Secrets; thereafter Pu penetrated the arts of the Five Agents, astronomy, and divination—averting calamity and shifting fortune without fixed method—even Jing Fang and Guan Lu could not surpass him.
translations.idiomatic: The master handed him nine volumes of The Satchel of Azure Secrets; Guo Pu thereby mastered the Five Agents, astronomy, and milfoil divination, turning aside disasters with uncanny ease—skills said to eclipse Jing Fang and Guan Lu.

sentences.zh: 璞門人趙載嘗竊《青襄書》，未及讀，而為火所焚。

translations.literal: Pu's disciple Zhao Zai once stole The Satchel of Azure Fragrance; before he could read it fire burned it.
translations.idiomatic: Disciple Zhao Zai once stole the azure satchel text; flames consumed it before he could open a page.

sentences.zh: 惠懷之際，河東先擾。

translations.literal: At the juncture of Hui and Huai emperors, Hedong was first disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: Between Emperors Hui and Huai turmoil struck Hedong first.

sentences.zh: 璞筮之，投策而歎曰：「嗟乎！

translations.literal: Pu divined it; cast stalks and sighed: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu cast the milfoil, threw down the stalks, and cried: "Alas!

sentences.zh: 黔黎將湮於異類，桑梓其翦為龍荒乎！」

translations.literal: The black-haired people will be drowned among alien kinds; will our mulberry home be cut down into dragon wasteland?"
translations.idiomatic: The black-haired people will be drowned among alien kinds; will our mulberry home be cut down into dragon wasteland?"

sentences.zh: 於是潛結姻昵及交遊數十家，欲避地東南。

translations.literal: Thereupon secretly bound marriage kin and travel friends several tens of houses—wished flee land southeast.
translations.idiomatic: He then quietly tied marriage ties and travel bonds with dozens of families, planning to escape southeast.

sentences.zh: 抵將軍趙固，會固所乘良馬死，固惜之，不接賓客。

translations.literal: He reached General Zhao Gu—happened Guo's ridden fine horse died—Guo prized it—did not receive guests.
translations.idiomatic: He came to General Zhao Gu while Zhao's prized mount had died; Zhao mourned the beast and refused visitors.

sentences.zh: 璞至，門吏不為通。

translations.literal: Pu arrived—gate clerks did not pass word.
translations.idiomatic: Gatekeepers barred Guo Pu when he arrived.

sentences.zh: 璞曰：「吾能活馬。」

translations.literal: Guo Pu said: "I can bring the horse back to life."
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu said: "I can bring the horse back to life."

sentences.zh: 吏驚入白固。

translations.literal: Clerk astonished entered reported Gu.
translations.idiomatic: Startled guards rushed within to tell Zhao Gu.

sentences.zh: 固趨出，曰：「君能活吾馬乎？」

translations.literal: Guo hurried out—said: Sir can revive my horse?
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Gu hurried forth demanding: "Can you truly revive my horse?"

sentences.zh: 璞曰：「得健夫二三十人，皆持長竿，東行三十里，有丘林社廟者，便以竿打拍，當得一物，宜急持歸。

translations.literal: Pu said: Obtain sturdy fellows twenty-thirty men—all hold long poles—east go thirty li—where mound grove shrine spirits—then with poles strike drum—ought obtain one thing—fit urgently carry back.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu instructed: "Take twenty or thirty sturdy men with long poles. Thirty li east stand hills, woods, and village shrines; beat every shrine until something appears—snatch it and run home.

sentences.zh: 得此，馬活矣。」

translations.literal: Obtain this—horse lives.
translations.idiomatic: Bring that thing here and the horse will rise."

sentences.zh: 固如其言，果得一物似猴，持歸。

translations.literal: Guo acted as said—indeed obtained one thing resembling monkey—carried back.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Gu obeyed; his men returned clutching a monkey-like creature.

sentences.zh: 此物見死馬，便噓吸其鼻。

translations.literal: This creature saw dead horse—then blew sucked its nose.
translations.idiomatic: Set beside the corpse it breathed into the nostrils.

sentences.zh: 頃之馬起，奮迅嘶鳴，食如常，不復見向物。

translations.literal: Shortly horse rose—sprang swift neighed—ate as usual—no longer saw former creature.
translations.idiomatic: Moments later the horse lurched up, neighed, and fed as always while the creature vanished.

sentences.zh: 固奇之，厚加資給。

translations.literal: Guo marvelled at him—greatly added provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Gu stood amazed and rewarded him lavishly.

sentences.zh: 行至廬江，太守胡孟康被丞相召為軍諮祭酒。

translations.literal: Going reached Lujiang—Grand Administrator Hu Mengkang was summoned by Chancellor as army advisory libationer.
translations.idiomatic: At Lujiang, Prefect Hu Mengkang received summons from the chancellor to serve as army counsellor and libationer.

sentences.zh: 時江淮清宴，孟康安之，無心南渡。

translations.literal: At time Jiang-Hai clear banquet—Mengkang settled it—no mind south crossing.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangzi region seemed tranquil, so Hu rested easy and saw no need to flee south.

sentences.zh: 璞為占曰「敗」。

translations.literal: Guo Pu divined for him and said, "Defeat."
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu divined for him and said, "Defeat."

sentences.zh: 康不之信。

translations.literal: Kang did not believe it.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Mengkang refused to credit it.

sentences.zh: 璞將促裝去之，愛主人婢，無由而得，乃取小豆三斗，繞主人宅散之。

translations.literal: Pu about urge pack leave—loved master's slave girl—no means obtain—then took small beans three pecks—around master's house scattered them.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu meant to pack out yet coveted his host's maid; unable to win her openly he scattered three pecks of beans around the compound.

sentences.zh: 主人晨見赤衣人數千圍其家，就視則滅，甚惡之，請璞為卦。

translations.literal: Master dawn saw red-clothed men thousand surround his house—approached looked then vanished—greatly hated it—begged Pu cast hexagram.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the host saw thousands of red figures ringing his halls; they vanished on approach. Uneasy, he asked Guo Pu for a reading.

sentences.zh: 璞曰：「君家不宜畜此婢，可于東南二十里賣之，慎勿爭價，則此妖可除也。」

translations.literal: Guo Pu said: "Your household should not keep this maidservant. Sell her twenty li to the southeast, and be careful not to haggle over the price; then this haunting can be removed."
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu said: "Your household should not keep this maidservant. Sell her twenty li to the southeast, and be careful not to haggle over the price; then this haunting can be removed."

sentences.zh: 主人從之。

translations.literal: Master followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The master complied.

sentences.zh: 璞陰令人賤買此婢。

translations.literal: Pu secretly ordered men cheap buy this maid.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu secretly sent buyers to purchase her cheap.

sentences.zh: 復為符投于井中，數千赤衣人皆反縛，一一自投于井，主人大悅。

translations.literal: Again made talisman cast into well—several thousand red-clothes men all reverse bound—one by one self cast into well—master greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: He dropped another charm into the well; thousands of red phantoms appeared bound hand and foot and plunged after it, delighting the host.

sentences.zh: 璞攜婢去。

translations.literal: Pu carried maid away.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu walked away with the girl.

sentences.zh: 後數旬而廬江陷。

translations.literal: After several tens ten-days then Lujiang fell.
translations.idiomatic: Within weeks Lujiang fell to the enemy.

sentences.zh: 璞既過江，宣城太守殷祐引為參軍。

translations.literal: Pu having crossed river—Xuancheng Grand Administrator Yin You led him as aide.
translations.idiomatic: After crossing the Yangzi Guo Pu joined Xuancheng prefect Yin You as military adviser.

sentences.zh: 時有物大如水牛，灰色卑腳，腳類象，胸前尾上皆白，大力而遲鈍，來到城下，眾咸異焉。

translations.literal: At time was creature large as water buffalo—grey low feet—feet like elephant—chest front tail top all white—great strength yet sluggish—came beneath walls—all marvelled.
translations.idiomatic: A beast as big as a buffalo—grey hide, stub legs like an elephant's, white chest and tail—strong but sluggish—appeared below the walls and amazed everyone.

sentences.zh: 祐使人伏而取之，令璞作卦，遇《遁》之《蠱》，其卦曰：「《艮》體連《乾》，其物壯巨。

translations.literal: You ordered men lie wait seize it—ordered Pu cast hexagram—met Dun toward Gu—the hexagram says: Gen body joins Qian—the creature stout huge.
translations.idiomatic: Yin You had it trapped and told Guo Pu to divine; the cast ran Retreat turning into Corruption: "Gen rests upon Qian—the beast is massive.

sentences.zh: 山潛之畜，匪兕匪武。

translations.literal: Mountain lurking beast—not rhino not martial.
translations.idiomatic: A creature lurking in the hills—neither rhinoceros nor tiger.

sentences.zh: 身與鬼並，精見二午。

translations.literal: Body with spirits together—essence sees two noon.
translations.idiomatic: Its body mingles ghosts; omens pair on the noon stems.

sentences.zh: 法當為禽，兩靈不許。

translations.literal: Rule ought become quarry—two spirits not permit.
translations.idiomatic: Justice names it prey, yet twin spirits withhold consent.

sentences.zh: 遂被一創，還其本墅。

translations.literal: Then suffers one wound—returns its native haunt.
translations.idiomatic: One wound drives it home to its mountain den.

sentences.zh: 按卦名之，是為驢鼠。」

translations.literal: According hexagram name it—this is donkey-rat.
translations.idiomatic: Name it by the hexagram—call it the donkey-rat."

sentences.zh: 卜適了，伏者以戟刺之，深尺餘，遂去不復見。

translations.literal: Divination just finished—ambushers with halberd stabbed it—deep over chi—then departed no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as the reading ended ambushers thrust halberds a foot deep; the thing fled unseen.

sentences.zh: 郡綱紀上祠，請殺之。

translations.literal: Commandery clerk ascended shrine—begged kill it.
translations.idiomatic: County officers petitioned the shrine gods for permission to kill it.

sentences.zh: 巫云：「廟神不悅，曰：『此是䢼亭驢山君鼠，使詣荊山，暫來過我，不須觸之。』」

translations.literal: The shaman said: "The temple spirit is displeased and says, 'This is Lord Rat of Donkey Mountain at Gongting. He is being sent to Jing Mountain and has only come to pass by me for a while; you need not touch him.'"
translations.idiomatic: The shaman said: "The temple spirit is displeased and says, 'This is Lord Rat of Donkey Mountain at Gongting. He is being sent to Jing Mountain and has only come to pass by me for a while; you need not touch him.'"

sentences.zh: 其精妙如此。

translations.literal: His subtle skill was like this.
translations.idiomatic: His subtle skill was like this.

sentences.zh: 祐遷石頭督護，璞復隨之。

translations.literal: You transferred Stone Citadel protector—Pu again followed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yin You moved to command Stone Citadel Guo Pu followed.

sentences.zh: 時有鼯鼠出延陵，璞占之曰：「此郡東當有妖人欲稱制者，尋亦自死矣。

translations.literal: At time flying squirrel emerged Yanling—Pu divined saying: This commandery east ought have freakish man wishes claim mandate—soon also self dies.
translations.idiomatic: When a giant flying squirrel appeared at Yanling Guo Pu foretold: "East of this commandery a sorcerer will seize the mandate—and soon perish.

sentences.zh: 後當有妖樹生，然若瑞而非瑞，辛螫之木也。

translations.literal: Later ought have freakish tree grow—yet like auspicious yet not auspicious—pungent sting tree.
translations.idiomatic: Later an uncanny tree will sprout—looking auspicious yet poisonous as nettles.

sentences.zh: 儻有此者，東南數百里必有作逆者，期明年矣。」

translations.literal: If have this one—southeast several hundred li ought have rebellion-maker—deadline next year.
translations.idiomatic: Should it appear, rebels will stir within a few hundred li southeast within the coming year."

sentences.zh: 無錫縣欻有茱萸四株交枝而生，若連理者，其年盜殺吳興太守袁琇。

translations.literal: Wuxi county suddenly had four cornus trees intertwining branches growing—as joined principle—that year bandits killed Wuxing Grand Administrator Yuan Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: Cornus trees in Wuxi suddenly intertwined like paired trunks; that year bandits slew Wuxing prefect Yuan Xiu.

sentences.zh: 或以問璞，璞曰：「卯爻發而沴金，此木不曲直而成災也。」

translations.literal: Someone asked Guo Pu about it, and Pu said: "The mao line was activated and harmed Metal; this is Wood not being bent or straight and becoming disaster."
translations.idiomatic: Someone asked Guo Pu about it, and Pu said: "The mao line was activated and harmed Metal; this is Wood not being bent or straight and becoming disaster."

sentences.zh: 王導深重之，引參己軍事。

translations.literal: Wang Dao deeply prized him—led join own military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dao esteemed him and brought him onto staff.

sentences.zh: 嘗令作卦，璞言：「公有震厄，可命駕西出數十里，得一柏樹，截斷如身長，置常寢處，災當可消矣。」

translations.literal: Wang Dao once had him make a hexagram, and Guo Pu said: "My lord has a thunder calamity. You may order your carriage driven several tens of li west, obtain a cypress tree, cut it to the length of your body, and place it where you normally sleep; the disaster should then be dispelled."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dao once had him make a hexagram, and Guo Pu said: "My lord has a thunder calamity. You may order your carriage driven several tens of li west, obtain a cypress tree, cut it to the length of your body, and place it where you normally sleep; the disaster should then be dispelled."

sentences.zh: 導從其言。

translations.literal: Dao followed his words.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dao obeyed.

sentences.zh: 數日果震，柏樹粉碎。

translations.literal: Several days indeed thunder—cypress tree smashed splintered.
translations.idiomatic: Days later lightning struck and shattered the timber.

sentences.zh: 時元帝初鎮鄴，導令璞筮之，遇《咸》之《井》，璞曰：「東北郡縣有『武』名者，當出鐸，以著受命之符。

translations.literal: At time Yuan Emperor first garrisoned Ye—Dao ordered Pu divine—met Xian toward Jing—Pu said: Northeast commanderies counties having Wu name—ought produce bell-clapper—to manifest receiving mandate token.
translations.idiomatic: While Yuan Emperor still held Ye Wang Dao had Guo Pu cast lots; the hexagram ran Concord turning into Well: "A county northeast bearing the syllable Wu will yield bronze clappers proving Heaven's mandate.

sentences.zh: 西南郡縣有『陽』名者，井當沸。」

translations.literal: Southwest commanderies counties having Yang name—well ought boil.
translations.idiomatic: Where southwest counties bear Yang in their names village wells will boil."

sentences.zh: 其後晉陵武進縣人于田中得銅鐸五枚，曆陽縣中井沸，經日乃止。

translations.literal: Afterward Jinling Wujin county men in fields obtained bronze clappers five pieces—Liyang county central wells boiled—passed days then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Soon peasants at Wujin in Jinling dug up five bronze bells while wells seethed in Liyang for days.

sentences.zh: 及帝為晉王，又使璞筮，遇《豫》之《睽》，璞曰：「會稽當出鐘，以告成功，上有勒銘，應在人家井泥中得之。

translations.literal: When Emperor became Jin king—again ordered Pu divine—met Yu toward Kui—Pu said: Kuaiji ought produce bell—to announce completion merit—top has carved inscription—response at people's home well mud within obtain it.
translations.idiomatic: After Sima Rui became Jin prince Guo Pu cast again; Rest turning into Opposition foretold: "Kuaiji will yield a triumph bell bearing an inscription dredged from household wells.

sentences.zh: 繇辭所謂'先王以作樂崇德，殷薦之上帝'者也。」

translations.literal: Xi commentary so-called 'Former kings used making music honour virtue—richly present Supreme Lord' those.
translations.idiomatic: This matches Xi Ci's line that ancient kings shaped music to magnify virtue and offered it lavishly on high."

sentences.zh: 及帝即位，太興初，會稽剡縣人果于井中得一鐘，長七寸二分，口徑四寸半，上有古文奇書十八字，云「會稽嶽命」，余字時人莫識之。

translations.literal: After the emperor ascended the throne, early in Taixing, people of Shan county in Kuaiji indeed found a bell in a well. It was seven cun and two fen long, its mouth was four and a half cun across, and on it were eighteen strange archaic characters saying "Kuaiji Peak Mandate"; the people of the time did not recognize the remaining characters.
translations.idiomatic: After the emperor ascended the throne, early in Taixing, people of Shan county in Kuaiji indeed found a bell in a well. It was seven cun and two fen long, its mouth was four and a half cun across, and on it were eighteen strange archaic characters saying "Kuaiji Peak Mandate"; the people of the time did not recognize the remaining characters.

sentences.zh: 璞曰：「蓋王者之作，必有靈符，塞天人之心，與神物合契，然後可以言受命矣。

translations.literal: Pu said: Cover king's undertaking—must have spirit tally—block heaven man's hearts—with divine objects match tally—afterwards can speak receiving mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu declared: "True kings always earn spirit tallies that seal heaven and men's wills and align with sacred relics—only then may they speak of mandate.

sentences.zh: 觀五鐸啟號于晉陵，棧鐘告成於會稽，瑞不失類，出皆以方，豈不偉哉！

translations.literal: Observe five clappers open cry at Jinling—pile bell announce completion at Kuaiji—omens not miss classes—issue all by quarter—is it not grand!
translations.idiomatic: Five clappers hailed Jinling while Kuaiji's bell proclaimed completion—omens arrive by kind and quarter—is this not majestic!

sentences.zh: 若夫鐸發其響，鐘征其象，器以數臻，事以實應，天人之際不可不察。」

translations.literal: As for the clappers sending forth their sound and the bell verifying its image, implements arrived according to number and affairs answered in fact; the border between Heaven and man must be examined."
translations.idiomatic: As for the clappers sending forth their sound and the bell verifying its image, implements arrived according to number and affairs answered in fact; the border between Heaven and man must be examined."

sentences.zh: 帝甚重之。

translations.literal: Emperor greatly prized him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor prized him highly.

sentences.zh: 璞著《江賦》，其辭甚偉，為世所稱。

translations.literal: Pu composed River Fu—its phrasing very grand—by age praised.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu's River Fu moved readers with its grandeur.

sentences.zh: 後復作《南郊賦》，帝見而嘉之，以為著作佐郎。

translations.literal: Later again composed Southern Suburb Fu—Emperor saw and praised—made him collator-author aide.
translations.idiomatic: His Southern Suburb Fu delighted the throne and earned appointment as assistant editor.

sentences.zh: 于時陰陽錯繆，而刑獄繁興，璞上疏曰：臣聞《春秋》之義，貴元慎始，故分至啟閉以觀雲物，所以顯天人之統，存休咎之徵。

translations.literal: At that time yin and yang were in confusion and criminal punishments and prisons were multiplying, so Guo Pu submitted a memorial: I have heard that the meaning of the Chunqiu values making the beginning correct and cautious; therefore the divisions, solstices, openings, and closings are used to observe clouds and phenomena, revealing the unity of Heaven and man and preserving signs of good and ill.
translations.idiomatic: At that time yin and yang were in confusion and criminal punishments and prisons were multiplying, so Guo Pu submitted a memorial: I have heard that the meaning of the Chunqiu values making the beginning correct and cautious; therefore the divisions, solstices, openings, and closings are used to observe clouds and phenomena, revealing the unity of Heaven and man and preserving signs of good and ill.

sentences.zh: 臣不揆淺見，輒依歲首粗有所占，卦得《解》之《既濟》。

translations.literal: I do not measure my shallow views, but roughly made a divination according to the beginning of the year, and the hexagram was Jie changing to Jiji.
translations.idiomatic: I do not measure my shallow views, but roughly made a divination according to the beginning of the year, and the hexagram was Jie changing to Jiji.

sentences.zh: 案爻論思，方涉春木王龍德之時，而為廢水之氣來見乘，加升陽未布，隆陰仍積，《坎》為法象，刑獄所麗，變《坎》加《離》，厥象不燭。

translations.literal: Examining the lines and considering them, we are just entering spring, when Wood is ascendant and dragon virtue is in season, yet the qi of spent Water has come to ride upon it; moreover rising yang has not yet spread, deep yin still accumulates, Kan is the image for law, prisons are what it attaches to, and when Kan changes and Li is added, the image is not bright.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the lines and considering them, we are just entering spring, when Wood is ascendant and dragon virtue is in season, yet the qi of spent Water has come to ride upon it; moreover rising yang has not yet spread, deep yin still accumulates, Kan is the image for law, prisons are what it attaches to, and when Kan changes and Li is added, the image is not bright.

sentences.zh: 以義推之，皆為刑獄殷繁，理有壅濫。

translations.literal: When this is inferred by meaning, all of it indicates that punishments and prisons are numerous and that principles are blocked and excessive.
translations.idiomatic: When this is inferred by meaning, all of it indicates that punishments and prisons are numerous and that principles are blocked and excessive.

sentences.zh: 又去年十二月二十九日，太白蝕月。

translations.literal: Also, on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month last year, Taibai eclipsed the moon.
translations.idiomatic: Also, on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month last year, Taibai eclipsed the moon.

sentences.zh: 月者屬《坎》，群陰之府，所以照察幽情，以佐太陽者也。

translations.literal: The moon belongs to Kan and is the storehouse of the many yin; it illuminates hidden feelings in order to assist the great yang.
translations.idiomatic: The moon belongs to Kan and is the storehouse of the many yin; it illuminates hidden feelings in order to assist the great yang.

sentences.zh: 太白，金行之星，而來犯之，天意若曰刑理失中，自壞其所以為法者也。

translations.literal: Taibai is the star of the Metal phase, and its coming to offend the moon is as if Heaven were saying that judicial principle has lost the mean and has damaged the very thing by which it makes law.
translations.idiomatic: Taibai is the star of the Metal phase, and its coming to offend the moon is as if Heaven were saying that judicial principle has lost the mean and has damaged the very thing by which it makes law.

sentences.zh: 臣術學庸近，不練內事，卦理所及，敢不盡言。

translations.literal: My arts and learning are ordinary and shallow, and I am not practiced in inner affairs, but where hexagram principle reaches, I dare not fail to speak fully.
translations.idiomatic: My arts and learning are ordinary and shallow, and I am not practiced in inner affairs, but where hexagram principle reaches, I dare not fail to speak fully.

sentences.zh: 又去秋以來，沈雨跨年，雖為金家涉火之祥，然亦是刑獄充溢，怨歎之氣所致。

translations.literal: Again, since last autumn, heavy rains have crossed into the new year. Although this is an omen of the Metal house crossing Fire, it is also caused by the qi of prisons and punishments overflowing and by resentment and sighs.
translations.idiomatic: Again, since last autumn, heavy rains have crossed into the new year. Although this is an omen of the Metal house crossing Fire, it is also caused by the qi of prisons and punishments overflowing and by resentment and sighs.

sentences.zh: 往建興四年十二月中，行丞相令史淳于伯刑于市，而血逆流長標。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Jianxing, acting Chancellor Clerk Chunyu Bo was executed in the market, and his blood flowed backward up the tall marker.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the fourth year of Jianxing, acting Chancellor Clerk Chunyu Bo was executed in the market, and his blood flowed backward up the tall marker.

sentences.zh: 伯者小人，雖罪在未允，何足感動靈變，致若斯之怪邪！

translations.literal: Bo was a petty man, and though his guilt was not yet settled, how could he be enough to move numinous transformations and bring about a prodigy like this?
translations.idiomatic: Bo was a petty man, and though his guilt was not yet settled, how could he be enough to move numinous transformations and bring about a prodigy like this?

sentences.zh: 明皇天所以保祐金家，子愛陛下，屢見災異，殷勤無已。

translations.literal: This shows clearly that august Heaven protects the Metal house and loves Your Majesty like a son, repeatedly displaying disasters and anomalies with unceasing earnestness.
translations.idiomatic: This shows clearly that august Heaven protects the Metal house and loves Your Majesty like a son, repeatedly displaying disasters and anomalies with unceasing earnestness.

sentences.zh: 陛下宜側身思懼，以應靈譴。

translations.literal: Your Majesty should turn inward in fear and reflection in order to answer the numinous rebuke.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty should turn inward in fear and reflection in order to answer the numinous rebuke.

sentences.zh: 皇極之謫，事不虛降。

translations.literal: Rebukes from the imperial pivot do not descend emptily.
translations.idiomatic: Rebukes from the imperial pivot do not descend emptily.

sentences.zh: 不然，恐將來必有愆陽苦雨之災，崩震薄蝕之變，狂狡蠢戾之妖，以益陛下旰食之勞也。

translations.literal: Otherwise, I fear that in the future there will certainly be disasters of excessive yang and bitter rains, changes of collapse, thunder, and eclipses, and portents of mad and perverse creatures, adding to Your Majesty's labor of eating late.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, I fear that in the future there will certainly be disasters of excessive yang and bitter rains, changes of collapse, thunder, and eclipses, and portents of mad and perverse creatures, adding to Your Majesty's labor of eating late.

sentences.zh: 臣謹尋按舊經，《尚書》有五事供禦之術，京房《易傳》有消復之救，所以緣咎而致慶，因異而邁政。

translations.literal: I have carefully sought through the old classics: the Shangshu has arts for responding to the Five Matters, and Jing Fang's Yizhuan has rescues for waning and returning; these are ways to follow blame and bring about blessing, and to use anomalies to advance government.
translations.idiomatic: I have carefully sought through the old classics: the Shangshu has arts for responding to the Five Matters, and Jing Fang's Yizhuan has rescues for waning and returning; these are ways to follow blame and bring about blessing, and to use anomalies to advance government.

sentences.zh: 故木不生庭，太戊無以隆；雉不鳴鼎，武丁不為宗。

translations.literal: Thus, if the tree had not grown in the court, Taiwu would have had no way to flourish; if the pheasant had not cried on the cauldron, Wuding would not have become an ancestral lord.
translations.idiomatic: Thus, if the tree had not grown in the court, Taiwu would have had no way to flourish; if the pheasant had not cried on the cauldron, Wuding would not have become an ancestral lord.

sentences.zh: 夫寅畏者所以饗福，怠傲者所以招患，此自然之符應，不可不察也。

translations.literal: Reverent fear is what receives blessing, while indolence and arrogance are what summon disaster; these natural signs and responses must be examined.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent fear is what receives blessing, while indolence and arrogance are what summon disaster; these natural signs and responses must be examined.

sentences.zh: 案《解卦》繇云：「君子以赦過宥罪。」

translations.literal: According to the line text of the Jie hexagram: "The gentleman pardons errors and forgives crimes."
translations.idiomatic: According to the line text of the Jie hexagram: "The gentleman pardons errors and forgives crimes."

sentences.zh: 《既濟》云：「思患而豫防之。」

translations.literal: The Jiji hexagram says: "He thinks of danger and guards against it beforehand."
translations.idiomatic: The Jiji hexagram says: "He thinks of danger and guards against it beforehand."

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為宜發哀矜之詔，引在予之責，蕩除瑕釁，贊陽布惠，使幽斃之人應蒼生以悅育，否滯之氣隨穀風而紓散。

translations.literal: In my foolish view, You should issue an edict of pity, take the responsibility upon Yourself, sweep away flaws and offenses, assist yang by spreading favor, and cause those hidden and destroyed to answer the common people with joy and nurture, while blocked and stagnant qi disperses with the valley wind.
translations.idiomatic: In my foolish view, You should issue an edict of pity, take the responsibility upon Yourself, sweep away flaws and offenses, assist yang by spreading favor, and cause those hidden and destroyed to answer the common people with joy and nurture, while blocked and stagnant qi disperses with the valley wind.

sentences.zh: 此亦寄時事以制用，藉開塞而曲成者也。

translations.literal: This too is a way of lodging use in the affairs of the time and borrowing opening and closing to bring things to completion indirectly.
translations.idiomatic: This too is a way of lodging use in the affairs of the time and borrowing opening and closing to bring things to completion indirectly.

sentences.zh: 臣竊觀陛下貞明仁恕，體之自然，天假其祚，奄有區夏，啟重光於已昧，廓四祖之遐武，祥靈表瑞，人鬼獻謀，應天順時，殆不尚此。

translations.literal: I privately observe that Your Majesty is upright, bright, humane, and forgiving, embodying these things naturally; Heaven has granted You its fortune, and You possess all the central lands, opened renewed radiance when matters had grown dim, and enlarged the distant martial work of the four ancestors; auspicious spirits have shown omens, men and spirits have offered plans, and in responding to Heaven and following the time, nothing could surpass this.
translations.idiomatic: I privately observe that Your Majesty is upright, bright, humane, and forgiving, embodying these things naturally; Heaven has granted You its fortune, and You possess all the central lands, opened renewed radiance when matters had grown dim, and enlarged the distant martial work of the four ancestors; auspicious spirits have shown omens, men and spirits have offered plans, and in responding to Heaven and following the time, nothing could surpass this.

sentences.zh: 然陛下即位以來，中興之化未闡，雖躬綜萬機，勞逾日昃，玄澤未加於群生，聲教未被乎宇宙，臣主未甯於上，黔細未輯於下，《鴻雁》之詠不興，康衢之歌不作者，何也？

translations.literal: Yet since Your Majesty ascended the throne, the transformation of restoration has not been made clear; though You personally manage ten thousand affairs and labor past sundown, dark beneficence has not reached the many lives, instruction has not covered the universe, lord and ministers are not at peace above, and the common people are not gathered below. Why are the songs of Hongyan not raised and the songs of the broad road not composed?
translations.idiomatic: Yet since Your Majesty ascended the throne, the transformation of restoration has not been made clear; though You personally manage ten thousand affairs and labor past sundown, dark beneficence has not reached the many lives, instruction has not covered the universe, lord and ministers are not at peace above, and the common people are not gathered below. Why are the songs of Hongyan not raised and the songs of the broad road not composed?

sentences.zh: 杖道之情未著，而任刑之風先彰，經國之略未震，而軌物之跡屢遷。

translations.literal: The feeling of relying on the Way has not yet appeared, while the habit of relying on punishment has first become manifest; the strategy for ordering the state has not yet shaken the age, while the traces by which things are regulated have repeatedly shifted.
translations.idiomatic: The feeling of relying on the Way has not yet appeared, while the habit of relying on punishment has first become manifest; the strategy for ordering the state has not yet shaken the age, while the traces by which things are regulated have repeatedly shifted.

sentences.zh: 夫法令不一則人情惑，職次數改則覬覦生，官方不審則秕政作，懲勸不明則善惡渾，此有國者之所慎也。

translations.literal: When laws and commands are not unified, people's feelings are confused; when offices and ranks are repeatedly changed, covetous hopes arise; when official methods are not examined, bad policies are produced; when punishment and encouragement are unclear, good and evil become muddled. These are what possessors of states are careful about.
translations.idiomatic: When laws and commands are not unified, people's feelings are confused; when offices and ranks are repeatedly changed, covetous hopes arise; when official methods are not examined, bad policies are produced; when punishment and encouragement are unclear, good and evil become muddled. These are what possessors of states are careful about.

sentences.zh: 臣竊為陛下惜之。

translations.literal: I privately grieve over this for Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: I privately grieve over this for Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 夫以區區之曹參，猶能遵蓋公之一言，倚清靖以鎮俗，寄市獄以容非，德音不忘，流詠於今。

translations.literal: Even a small man like Cao Shen could still follow a single word from Master Gai, rely on purity and quiet to settle customs, and entrust markets and prisons with room for mistakes; his virtuous sound was not forgotten and has flowed in song down to the present.
translations.idiomatic: Even a small man like Cao Shen could still follow a single word from Master Gai, rely on purity and quiet to settle customs, and entrust markets and prisons with room for mistakes; his virtuous sound was not forgotten and has flowed in song down to the present.

sentences.zh: 漢之中宗，聰悟獨斷，可謂令主，然厲意刑名，用虧純德。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhongzong of Han was intelligent, perceptive, and decisive, and may be called a good ruler, yet by sharpening his attention on punishments and names he damaged pure virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhongzong of Han was intelligent, perceptive, and decisive, and may be called a good ruler, yet by sharpening his attention on punishments and names he damaged pure virtue.

sentences.zh: 《老子》以禮為忠信之薄，況刑又是禮之糟粕者乎！

translations.literal: The Laozi takes ritual to be the thinning of loyalty and trust; how much more is punishment the dregs of ritual!
translations.idiomatic: The Laozi takes ritual to be the thinning of loyalty and trust; how much more is punishment the dregs of ritual!

sentences.zh: 夫無為而為之，不宰以宰之，固陛下之所體者也。

translations.literal: To act by not acting and govern by not mastering is surely what Your Majesty embodies.
translations.idiomatic: To act by not acting and govern by not mastering is surely what Your Majesty embodies.

sentences.zh: 恥其君不為堯舜者，亦豈惟古人！

translations.literal: Those ashamed that their ruler is not Yao or Shun are surely not only men of antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Those ashamed that their ruler is not Yao or Shun are surely not only men of antiquity.

sentences.zh: 是以敢肆狂瞽，不隱其懷。

translations.literal: For this reason I dare to indulge my mad blindness and do not hide what is in my heart.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason I dare to indulge my mad blindness and do not hide what is in my heart.

sentences.zh: 若臣言可采，或所以為塵露之益；若不足采，所以廣聽納之門。

translations.literal: If my words can be adopted, perhaps they may offer the benefit of dust and dew; if they are not worth adopting, they may still broaden the gate of hearing and accepting advice.
translations.idiomatic: If my words can be adopted, perhaps they may offer the benefit of dust and dew; if they are not worth adopting, they may still broaden the gate of hearing and accepting advice.

sentences.zh: 願陛下少留神鑒，賜察臣言。

translations.literal: I beg Your Majesty to slightly retain Your divine discernment and grant examination to my words.
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to slightly retain Your divine discernment and grant examination to my words.

sentences.zh: 疏奏，優詔報之。

translations.literal: Memorial presented—gracious edict replied.
translations.idiomatic: The throne answered with a gracious rescript.

sentences.zh: 其後日有黑氣，璞復上疏曰：臣以頑昧，近者冒陳所見，陛下不遺狂言，事蒙禦省。

translations.literal: After this, black qi appeared in the sun, and Guo Pu again submitted a memorial: Because I am stubborn and ignorant, I recently ventured to state what I had seen; Your Majesty did not reject my mad words, and the matter received imperial review.
translations.idiomatic: After this, black qi appeared in the sun, and Guo Pu again submitted a memorial: Because I am stubborn and ignorant, I recently ventured to state what I had seen; Your Majesty did not reject my mad words, and the matter received imperial review.

sentences.zh: 伏讀聖詔，歡懼交戰。

translations.literal: I humbly read the sage edict, and joy and fear battled within me.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly read the sage edict, and joy and fear battled within me.

sentences.zh: 臣前雲升陽未布，隆陰仍積，《坎》為法象，刑獄所麗，變《坎》加《離》，厥象不燭，疑將來必有薄蝕之變也。

translations.literal: Earlier I said that rising yang had not yet spread and deep yin still accumulated; Kan was the image for law and was what punishments and prisons attach to, and when Kan changed and Li was added, its image was not bright. I suspected that in the future there would certainly be a change of dimming or eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier I said that rising yang had not yet spread and deep yin still accumulated; Kan was the image for law and was what punishments and prisons attach to, and when Kan changed and Li was added, its image was not bright. I suspected that in the future there would certainly be a change of dimming or eclipse.

sentences.zh: 此月四日，日出山六七丈，精光潛昧，而色都赤，中有異物大如雞子，又有青黑之氣共相薄擊，良久方解。

translations.literal: On the fourth day of this month, when the sun had risen six or seven zhang above the mountains, its pure light was hidden and its color was entirely red; within it was an anomalous object as large as a chicken egg, and blue-black qi also struck against it, only separating after a long while.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day of this month, when the sun had risen six or seven zhang above the mountains, its pure light was hidden and its color was entirely red; within it was an anomalous object as large as a chicken egg, and blue-black qi also struck against it, only separating after a long while.

sentences.zh: 案時在歲首純陽之月，日在癸亥全陰之位，而有此異，殆元首供禦之義不顯，消復之理不著之所致也。

translations.literal: Examining the time, it was the first month of the year, the month of pure yang, while the day was gui-hai, the position of complete yin, and yet this anomaly occurred. This was probably caused by the meaning of the ruler's response not being manifest and the principle of waning and returning not being made clear.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the time, it was the first month of the year, the month of pure yang, while the day was gui-hai, the position of complete yin, and yet this anomaly occurred. This was probably caused by the meaning of the ruler's response not being manifest and the principle of waning and returning not being made clear.

sentences.zh: 計去微臣所陳，未及一月，而便有此變，益明皇天留情陛下懇懇之至也。

translations.literal: Counting from what this humble minister stated, not yet one month had passed before this change occurred; this further clarifies that August Heaven fixes its concern on Your Majesty with the utmost earnestness.
translations.idiomatic: Counting from what this humble minister stated, not yet one month had passed before this change occurred; this further clarifies that August Heaven fixes its concern on Your Majesty with the utmost earnestness.

sentences.zh: 往年歲末，太白蝕月，今在歲始，日有咎謫。

translations.literal: At the end of last year Taibai eclipsed the moon; now at the beginning of the year the sun has shown rebuke.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of last year Taibai eclipsed the moon; now at the beginning of the year the sun has shown rebuke.

sentences.zh: 會未數旬，大眚再見。

translations.literal: Before even several tens of days had gathered, a great calamity appeared twice.
translations.idiomatic: Before even several tens of days had gathered, a great calamity appeared twice.

sentences.zh: 日月告釁，見懼詩人，無曰天高，其鑒不遠。

translations.literal: The sun and moon announce faults; the poets feared such things. Do not say Heaven is high, for its mirror is not far away.
translations.idiomatic: The sun and moon announce faults; the poets feared such things. Do not say Heaven is high, for its mirror is not far away.

sentences.zh: 故宋景言善，熒惑退次；光武甯亂，呼沲結冰。

translations.literal: Thus when Duke Jing of Song spoke good words, Mars withdrew its station; when Emperor Guangwu pacified disorder, the Hutuo River froze over.
translations.idiomatic: Thus when Duke Jing of Song spoke good words, Mars withdrew its station; when Emperor Guangwu pacified disorder, the Hutuo River froze over.

sentences.zh: 此明天人之懸符，有若形影之相應。

translations.literal: This makes clear that the suspended tally between Heaven and man responds like form and shadow.
translations.idiomatic: This makes clear that the suspended tally between Heaven and man responds like form and shadow.

sentences.zh: 應之以德，則休祥臻；酬之以怠，則咎征作。

translations.literal: Answer it with virtue, and auspicious blessings arrive; repay it with negligence, and signs of blame arise.
translations.idiomatic: Answer it with virtue, and auspicious blessings arrive; repay it with negligence, and signs of blame arise.

sentences.zh: 陛下宜恭承靈譴，敬天之怒，施沛然之恩，諧玄同之化，上所以允塞天意，下所以弭息群謗。

translations.literal: Your Majesty should reverently accept the numinous rebuke, respect Heaven's anger, dispense abundant grace, and harmonize with the darkly shared transformation, above thereby fulfilling Heaven's intent, below thereby stopping the many slanders.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty should reverently accept the numinous rebuke, respect Heaven's anger, dispense abundant grace, and harmonize with the darkly shared transformation, above thereby fulfilling Heaven's intent, below thereby stopping the many slanders.

sentences.zh: 臣聞人之多幸，國之不幸。

translations.literal: I have heard that many pardons for men are misfortune for the state.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that many pardons for men are misfortune for the state.

sentences.zh: 赦不宜數，實如聖旨。

translations.literal: That amnesties should not be frequent is truly as the sage instruction says.
translations.idiomatic: That amnesties should not be frequent is truly as the sage instruction says.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為子產之鑄刑書，非政事之善，然不得不作者，須以救弊故也。

translations.literal: In my foolish view, Zichan's casting of the penal writings was not good government, yet the reason he could not avoid doing it was that he needed it to rescue a defect.
translations.idiomatic: In my foolish view, Zichan's casting of the penal writings was not good government, yet the reason he could not avoid doing it was that he needed it to rescue a defect.

sentences.zh: 今之宜赦，理亦如之。

translations.literal: The propriety of an amnesty now follows the same principle.
translations.idiomatic: The propriety of an amnesty now follows the same principle.

sentences.zh: 隨時之宜，亦聖人所善者。

translations.literal: What suits the time is also what sages approve.
translations.idiomatic: What suits the time is also what sages approve.

sentences.zh: 此國家大信之要，誠非微臣所得幹豫。

translations.literal: This is the essential point of the state's great trust, and truly not something a petty servant may interfere in.
translations.idiomatic: This is the essential point of the state's great trust, and truly not something a petty servant may interfere in.

sentences.zh: 今聖朝明哲，思弘謀猷，方辟四門以亮采，訪輿誦於群心，況臣蒙珥筆朝末，而可不竭誠盡規哉！

translations.literal: Now the sage court is bright and wise and wishes to enlarge its plans, opening the four gates to illuminate talents and seeking the carriage songs in the hearts of the people. Since I have received a brush at the very edge of the court, how could I fail to exhaust sincerity and offer all my remonstrance?
translations.idiomatic: Now the sage court is bright and wise and wishes to enlarge its plans, opening the four gates to illuminate talents and seeking the carriage songs in the hearts of the people. Since I have received a brush at the very edge of the court, how could I fail to exhaust sincerity and offer all my remonstrance?

sentences.zh: 頃之遷尚書郎。

translations.literal: Shortly transferred Masters of Writing gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he rose to gentleman of the masters of writing.

sentences.zh: 數言便宜，多研匡益。

translations.literal: Repeatedly spoke convenience—many investigated aid profit.
translations.idiomatic: He tendered timely counsel that sharpened policy.

sentences.zh: 明帝之在東宮，與溫嶠、庾亮並有布衣之好，璞亦以才學見重，埒於嶠、亮，論者美之。

translations.literal: Ming Emperor's being Eastern Palace—with Wen Qiao, Yu Liang together had cloth-clothes friendship—Pu also by talent learning seen honoured—equal to Qiao, Liang—discoursers praised him.
translations.idiomatic: While Ming Emperor was heir Wen Qiao and Yu Liang enjoyed rustic friendship with him; Guo Pu matched them in scholarship and critics admired the pairing.

sentences.zh: 然性輕易，不修威儀，嗜酒好色，時或過度。

translations.literal: Yet nature light easy—did not cultivate awe deportment—loved wine loved beauty—times perhaps excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was careless of dignity, loved wine and women, and often overindulged.

sentences.zh: 著作郎干寶常誡之曰：「此非適性之道也。」

translations.literal: Editor Gan Bao often warned him: "This is not the Way to suit your nature."
translations.idiomatic: Editor Gan Bao often warned him: "This is not the Way to suit your nature."

sentences.zh: 璞曰：「吾所受有本限，用之恆恐不得盡，卿乃憂酒色之為患乎！」

translations.literal: Pu said: What I receive has root limit—using always fear not obtain exhaust—you yet worry wine beauty becoming peril!
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu replied: "My allotted span is finite—I fear exhausting life without tasting everything—and you fret over wine and beauty?"

sentences.zh: 璞既好卜筮，縉紳多笑之。

translations.literal: Pu since loved divination—gentry belts many laughed him.
translations.idiomatic: Officials mocked his obsession with divination.

sentences.zh: 又自以才高位卑，乃著《客傲》，其辭曰：客傲郭生曰：「玉以兼城為寶，士以知名為賢。

translations.literal: Again, because he considered his talent high and his rank low, he wrote Ke'ao, "The Guest's Pride." Its text says: A guest mocked Master Guo: "Jade is treasured when it is worth paired cities, and a gentleman is deemed worthy when his name is known.
translations.idiomatic: Again, because he considered his talent high and his rank low, he wrote Ke'ao, "The Guest's Pride." Its text says: A guest mocked Master Guo: "Jade is treasured when it is worth paired cities, and a gentleman is deemed worthy when his name is known.

sentences.zh: 明月不妄映，蘭葩豈虛鮮。

translations.literal: The bright moon does not shine at random; how could orchid blossoms be fresh in vain?
translations.idiomatic: The bright moon does not shine at random; how could orchid blossoms be fresh in vain?

sentences.zh: 今足下既以拔文秀于叢薈，廕弱根于慶雲，陵扶搖而竦翮，揮清瀾以濯鱗，而響不徹於一皋，價不登乎千金。

translations.literal: Now you have already drawn literary excellence out from tangled growth, sheltered weak roots beneath fortunate clouds, mounted the whirlwind and raised your wings, and stirred clear waves to wash your scales, yet your sound does not reach a single marsh and your price does not rise to a thousand in gold.
translations.idiomatic: Now you have already drawn literary excellence out from tangled growth, sheltered weak roots beneath fortunate clouds, mounted the whirlwind and raised your wings, and stirred clear waves to wash your scales, yet your sound does not reach a single marsh and your price does not rise to a thousand in gold.

sentences.zh: 傲岸榮悴之際，頡頏龍魚之間，進不為諧隱，退不為放言，無沈冥之韻，而希風乎嚴先，徒費思於贊味，摹《洞林》乎《連山》，尚何名乎！

translations.literal: Between pride and decline, between dragon and fish, when advancing you are not a harmonious recluse and when withdrawing you are not one who speaks freely; lacking the tone of deep obscurity, yet hoping to follow the style of Yan and Xian, you merely spend thought on praising flavors and model Donglin on Lianshan. What name is still left?
translations.idiomatic: Between pride and decline, between dragon and fish, when advancing you are not a harmonious recluse and when withdrawing you are not one who speaks freely; lacking the tone of deep obscurity, yet hoping to follow the style of Yan and Xian, you merely spend thought on praising flavors and model Donglin on Lianshan. What name is still left?

sentences.zh: 夫攀驪龍之髯，撫翠禽之毛，而不得絕霞肆、跨天津者，未之前聞也。」

translations.literal: As for climbing the black dragon's whiskers and stroking the feathers of the kingfisher, yet not being able to cut across the rosy market and cross the ford of Heaven, I have never heard of such a thing."
translations.idiomatic: As for climbing the black dragon's whiskers and stroking the feathers of the kingfisher, yet not being able to cut across the rosy market and cross the ford of Heaven, I have never heard of such a thing."

sentences.zh: 郭生粲然而笑曰：「鷦鷯不可與論雲翼，井蛙難與量海鰲。

translations.literal: Master Guo laughed brightly and said: "A wren cannot discuss cloud-wings, and a well frog is hard to use in measuring the sea turtle.
translations.idiomatic: Master Guo laughed brightly and said: "A wren cannot discuss cloud-wings, and a well frog is hard to use in measuring the sea turtle.

sentences.zh: 雖然，將祛子之惑，訊以未悟，其可乎？

translations.literal: Even so, may I dispel your delusion and question what you have not yet understood?
translations.idiomatic: Even so, may I dispel your delusion and question what you have not yet understood?

sentences.zh: 乃者地維中絕，乾光墜采，皇運暫回，廓祚淮海。

translations.literal: Recently the cords of earth were cut in the center and the light of Heaven fell from brightness; imperial fortune turned for a time, and the broad mandate opened over the Huai and the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the cords of earth were cut in the center and the light of Heaven fell from brightness; imperial fortune turned for a time, and the broad mandate opened over the Huai and the sea.

sentences.zh: 龍德時乘，群才雲駭，藹若鄧林之會逸翰，爛若溟海之納奔濤，不煩咨嗟之訪，不假蒲帛之招，羈九有之奇駿，咸總之於一朝，豈惟豐沛之英，南陽之豪！

translations.literal: Dragon virtue rode the season, and the many talents rose like clouds, thick as Denglin gathering soaring wings and splendid as the dark sea receiving rushing waves. Without needing anxious summons or invitations with rush mats and silk, the strange steeds bound across the nine regions were all gathered in one court; how could this be only the worthies of Feng and Pei or the heroes of Nanyang?
translations.idiomatic: Dragon virtue rode the season, and the many talents rose like clouds, thick as Denglin gathering soaring wings and splendid as the dark sea receiving rushing waves. Without needing anxious summons or invitations with rush mats and silk, the strange steeds bound across the nine regions were all gathered in one court; how could this be only the worthies of Feng and Pei or the heroes of Nanyang?

sentences.zh: 昆吾挺鋒，驌驦軒髦，杞梓競敷，蘭荑爭翹，嚶聲冠於伐木，援類繁乎拔茅。

translations.literal: Kunwu showed its edge, the Sushuang horse lifted its mane, catalpa and lacquer trees competed in spreading branches, orchid shoots vied in rising high; calls seeking friends crowned the Famu ode, and drawing up one's kind was more abundant than the Bamao image.
translations.idiomatic: Kunwu showed its edge, the Sushuang horse lifted its mane, catalpa and lacquer trees competed in spreading branches, orchid shoots vied in rising high; calls seeking friends crowned the Famu ode, and drawing up one's kind was more abundant than the Bamao image.

sentences.zh: 是以水無浪士，岩無幽人，刈蘭不暇，爨桂不給，安事錯薪乎！

translations.literal: Thus there were no wave-riding gentlemen in the waters and no hidden men in the cliffs; there was no leisure to cut orchids and not enough time to cook cassia. What need was there to arrange common firewood?
translations.idiomatic: Thus there were no wave-riding gentlemen in the waters and no hidden men in the cliffs; there was no leisure to cut orchids and not enough time to cook cassia. What need was there to arrange common firewood?

sentences.zh: 且夫窟泉之潛不思雲翬，熙冰之采不羨旭晞，混光耀於埃藹者，亦曷願滄浪之深，秋陽之映乎！

translations.literal: Moreover, a spring hidden in a cave does not think of cloud-brilliance, and the gleam of thawing ice does not envy the morning sun. One who mingles radiance in dust and haze, why would he long for the depth of Canglang or the reflection of autumn sunlight?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, a spring hidden in a cave does not think of cloud-brilliance, and the gleam of thawing ice does not envy the morning sun. One who mingles radiance in dust and haze, why would he long for the depth of Canglang or the reflection of autumn sunlight?

sentences.zh: 登降紛於九五，淪湧懸乎龍津。

translations.literal: Rising and descending are tangled at the nine-five place; sinking and surging hang at the dragon ford.
translations.idiomatic: Rising and descending are tangled at the nine-five place; sinking and surging hang at the dragon ford.

sentences.zh: 蚓蛾以不才陸槁，蟒蛇以騰騖暴鱗。

translations.literal: Earthworms and moths dry on land because they lack talent; boas and snakes expose their scales because they soar and gallop.
translations.idiomatic: Earthworms and moths dry on land because they lack talent; boas and snakes expose their scales because they soar and gallop.

sentences.zh: 連城之寶，藏於褐裏，三秀雖豔，糜於麗采。

translations.literal: A treasure worth linked cities is hidden inside coarse cloth; though the threefold fungus is brilliant, it is wasted amid beautiful colors.
translations.idiomatic: A treasure worth linked cities is hidden inside coarse cloth; though the threefold fungus is brilliant, it is wasted amid beautiful colors.

sentences.zh: 香惡乎芬？

translations.literal: Where can fragrance be fragrant?
translations.idiomatic: Where can fragrance be fragrant?

sentences.zh: 賈惡乎在？

translations.literal: Where can value reside?
translations.idiomatic: Where can value reside?

sentences.zh: 是以不塵不冥，不驪不騂，支離其神，蕭悴其形。

translations.literal: Thus one is neither dusty nor dark, neither black horse nor red horse; one lets the spirit be misshapen and the form grow withered.
translations.idiomatic: Thus one is neither dusty nor dark, neither black horse nor red horse; one lets the spirit be misshapen and the form grow withered.

sentences.zh: 形廢則神王，跡粗而名生。

translations.literal: When form is discarded, spirit flourishes; when traces are coarse, name is born.
translations.idiomatic: When form is discarded, spirit flourishes; when traces are coarse, name is born.

sentences.zh: 體全者為犧，至獨者不孤，傲俗者不得以自得，默覺者不足以涉無。

translations.literal: What keeps its body whole becomes a sacrificial victim; what is utterly alone is not solitary. One who is proud before the world cannot thereby possess himself, and one who silently awakens is not enough to cross into nonbeing.
translations.idiomatic: What keeps its body whole becomes a sacrificial victim; what is utterly alone is not solitary. One who is proud before the world cannot thereby possess himself, and one who silently awakens is not enough to cross into nonbeing.

sentences.zh: 故不恢心而形遺，不外累而智喪，無岩穴而冥寂，無江湖而放浪。

translations.literal: Therefore without broadening the mind one leaves form behind; without external entanglement one loses cleverness. There is no cliff cave and yet there is dark stillness; there are no rivers and lakes and yet there is free wandering.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore without broadening the mind one leaves form behind; without external entanglement one loses cleverness. There is no cliff cave and yet there is dark stillness; there are no rivers and lakes and yet there is free wandering.

sentences.zh: 玄悟不以應機，洞鑒不以昭曠。

translations.literal: Dark awakening does not respond to occasions, and penetrating vision does not make itself broadly bright.
translations.idiomatic: Dark awakening does not respond to occasions, and penetrating vision does not make itself broadly bright.

sentences.zh: 不物物我我，不是是非非。

translations.literal: One does not thing things or self the self; one does not right the right or wrong the wrong.
translations.idiomatic: One does not thing things or self the self; one does not right the right or wrong the wrong.

sentences.zh: 忘意非我意，意得非我懷。

translations.literal: Forgetting intention is not my intention; attaining intention is not my concern.
translations.idiomatic: Forgetting intention is not my intention; attaining intention is not my concern.

sentences.zh: 寄群籟乎無象，域萬殊於一歸。

translations.literal: One lodges the many pipes in formlessness and bounds the ten thousand differences in one return.
translations.idiomatic: One lodges the many pipes in formlessness and bounds the ten thousand differences in one return.

sentences.zh: 不壽殤子，不夭彭涓，不壯秋豪，不小太山。

translations.literal: One does not make the child who dies young long-lived, does not make Peng or Juan short-lived, does not make a fine autumn hair great, and does not make Mount Tai small.
translations.idiomatic: One does not make the child who dies young long-lived, does not make Peng or Juan short-lived, does not make a fine autumn hair great, and does not make Mount Tai small.

sentences.zh: 蚊淚與天地齊流，蜉蝣與大椿齒年。

translations.literal: Mosquito tears flow equally with Heaven and Earth, and the mayfly shares years with the great chun tree.
translations.idiomatic: Mosquito tears flow equally with Heaven and Earth, and the mayfly shares years with the great chun tree.

sentences.zh: 然一闔一開，兩儀之跡，一沖一溢，懸象之節，渙互期於寒暑，凋蔚要乎春秋。

translations.literal: Yet each closing and opening is the trace of the two powers, and each emptiness and overflowing is the rhythm of the suspended images; dispersal and interweaving are timed by cold and heat, while withering and flourishing depend on spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Yet each closing and opening is the trace of the two powers, and each emptiness and overflowing is the rhythm of the suspended images; dispersal and interweaving are timed by cold and heat, while withering and flourishing depend on spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 青陽之翠秀，龍豹之委穎，駿狼之長暉，玄陸之短景。

translations.literal: The emerald beauty of green yang, the drooping ears of dragon and leopard, the long brightness of Junlang, and the short shadows of dark land all have their season.
translations.idiomatic: The emerald beauty of green yang, the drooping ears of dragon and leopard, the long brightness of Junlang, and the short shadows of dark land all have their season.

sentences.zh: 故皋壤為悲欣之府，蝴蝶為物化之器矣。

translations.literal: Therefore marsh and soil become treasuries of sadness and joy, and the butterfly becomes the vessel of the transformation of things.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore marsh and soil become treasuries of sadness and joy, and the butterfly becomes the vessel of the transformation of things.

sentences.zh: 夫欣黎黃之音者，不顰蟪蛄之吟；豁雲台之觀者，必閟帶索之歡。

translations.literal: Those who rejoice in the music of Li and Huang do not frown at the cicada's chirp; those whose view opens onto Cloud Terrace must shut away the pleasure of a tied cord.
translations.idiomatic: Those who rejoice in the music of Li and Huang do not frown at the cicada's chirp; those whose view opens onto Cloud Terrace must shut away the pleasure of a tied cord.

sentences.zh: 縱蹈而詠采薺，擁璧而歎抱關。

translations.literal: One may step freely while singing Caiqi, or embrace a jade disk while sighing as a gatekeeper.
translations.idiomatic: One may step freely while singing Caiqi, or embrace a jade disk while sighing as a gatekeeper.

sentences.zh: 戰機心以外物，不能得意於一弦。

translations.literal: If the calculating mind battles with external things, it cannot obtain meaning from a single string.
translations.idiomatic: If the calculating mind battles with external things, it cannot obtain meaning from a single string.

sentences.zh: 悟往復于嗟歎，安可與言樂天者乎！

translations.literal: If one understands coming and going through sighs, how can one speak with him about delighting in Heaven?
translations.idiomatic: If one understands coming and going through sighs, how can one speak with him about delighting in Heaven?

sentences.zh: 若乃莊周偃蹇於漆園，老萊婆娑于林窟，嚴平澄漠於塵肆，梅真隱淪乎市卒，梁生吟嘯而矯跡，焦先混沌而槁杌，阮公昏酣而賣傲，翟叟遁形以倏忽。

translations.literal: As for Zhuang Zhou lounging in Qiyuan, Lao Lai wandering in forest caves, Yan Ping settling into clarity in the dusty market, Mei Zhen hiding among market servants, Master Liang chanting and whistling while correcting his traces, Jiao Xian in muddled stump-like stillness, Ruan Gong drunk and selling pride, and old Zhai vanishing in an instant:
translations.idiomatic: As for Zhuang Zhou lounging in Qiyuan, Lao Lai wandering in forest caves, Yan Ping settling into clarity in the dusty market, Mei Zhen hiding among market servants, Master Liang chanting and whistling while correcting his traces, Jiao Xian in muddled stump-like stillness, Ruan Gong drunk and selling pride, and old Zhai vanishing in an instant:

sentences.zh: 吾不能歲韻於數賢，故寂然玩此員策與智骨。」

translations.literal: I cannot keep yearly harmony with these several worthies, and so in stillness I play with this round divining board and wisdom bones."
translations.idiomatic: I cannot keep yearly harmony with these several worthies, and so in stillness I play with this round divining board and wisdom bones."

sentences.zh: 永昌元年，皇孫生，璞上疏曰：有道之君未嘗不以危自持，亂世之主未嘗不以安自居。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongchang, when the imperial grandson was born, Guo Pu submitted a memorial: Rulers who possess the Way have never failed to hold themselves as if in danger, and rulers of disordered ages have never failed to dwell as if secure.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongchang, when the imperial grandson was born, Guo Pu submitted a memorial: Rulers who possess the Way have never failed to hold themselves as if in danger, and rulers of disordered ages have never failed to dwell as if secure.

sentences.zh: 故存而不忘亡者，三代之所以興也；亡而自以為存者，三季之所以廢也。

translations.literal: Therefore those who survive yet do not forget perishing are why the Three Dynasties rose; those who are perishing yet think themselves secure are why the last ages of the Three Dynasties fell.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore those who survive yet do not forget perishing are why the Three Dynasties rose; those who are perishing yet think themselves secure are why the last ages of the Three Dynasties fell.

sentences.zh: 是以古之令主開納忠讜，以弼其違；標顯切直，用攻其失。

translations.literal: For this reason enlightened rulers of antiquity opened themselves to loyal and upright speech to correct what they violated, and marked and displayed urgent directness to attack their faults.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason enlightened rulers of antiquity opened themselves to loyal and upright speech to correct what they violated, and marked and displayed urgent directness to attack their faults.

sentences.zh: 至乃聞一善則拜，見規誡則懼。

translations.literal: They went so far that when they heard one good word they bowed, and when they saw admonition they were afraid.
translations.idiomatic: They went so far that when they heard one good word they bowed, and when they saw admonition they were afraid.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: Why was this?
translations.idiomatic: Why was this?

sentences.zh: 蓋不私其身，處天下以至公也。

translations.literal: It was because they did not privatize their own bodies, but treated the realm with utmost public-mindedness.
translations.idiomatic: It was because they did not privatize their own bodies, but treated the realm with utmost public-mindedness.

sentences.zh: 臣竊惟陛下符運至著，勳業至大，而中興之祚不隆、聖敬之風未躋者，殆由法令太明，刑教太峻。

translations.literal: I privately consider that Your Majesty's tally and fortune are most manifest and Your merits and achievements are most great, yet the mandate of restoration has not flourished and the style of sage reverence has not risen; this is probably because laws and commands are too bright and punishments and instruction too severe.
translations.idiomatic: I privately consider that Your Majesty's tally and fortune are most manifest and Your merits and achievements are most great, yet the mandate of restoration has not flourished and the style of sage reverence has not risen; this is probably because laws and commands are too bright and punishments and instruction too severe.

sentences.zh: 故水至清則無魚，政至察則眾乖，此自然之勢也。

translations.literal: When water is perfectly clear, there are no fish; when government is perfectly exacting, the multitude parts from it. This is the natural tendency.
translations.idiomatic: When water is perfectly clear, there are no fish; when government is perfectly exacting, the multitude parts from it. This is the natural tendency.

sentences.zh: 臣去春啟事，以囹圄充斥，陰陽不和，推之卦理，宜因郊祀作赦，以蕩滌瑕穢。

translations.literal: Last spring I submitted a matter, saying that prisons were full, yin and yang were not harmonious, and by inference from hexagram principle an amnesty should be made on the occasion of the suburban sacrifice in order to wash away flaws and filth.
translations.idiomatic: Last spring I submitted a matter, saying that prisons were full, yin and yang were not harmonious, and by inference from hexagram principle an amnesty should be made on the occasion of the suburban sacrifice in order to wash away flaws and filth.

sentences.zh: 不然，將來必有愆陽苦雨之災，崩震薄蝕之變，狂狡蠢戾之妖。

translations.literal: Otherwise, in the future there would certainly be disasters of excessive yang and bitter rain, changes of collapse, thunder, and eclipses, and portents of mad and perverse creatures.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, in the future there would certainly be disasters of excessive yang and bitter rain, changes of collapse, thunder, and eclipses, and portents of mad and perverse creatures.

sentences.zh: 其後月餘，日果薄鬥。

translations.literal: More than a month later, the sun indeed dimmed and contended.
translations.idiomatic: More than a month later, the sun indeed dimmed and contended.

sentences.zh: 去秋以來，諸郡並有暴雨，水皆洪潦，歲用無年。

translations.literal: Since last autumn, the commanderies have all had violent rains, and the waters have all been great floods, so the year has produced no harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Since last autumn, the commanderies have all had violent rains, and the waters have all been great floods, so the year has produced no harvest.

sentences.zh: 適聞吳興復欲有構妄者，咎征漸成，臣甚惡之。

translations.literal: I have just heard that in Wuxing there are again people who wish to construct false charges; signs of blame are gradually forming, and I deeply hate this.
translations.idiomatic: I have just heard that in Wuxing there are again people who wish to construct false charges; signs of blame are gradually forming, and I deeply hate this.

sentences.zh: 頃者以來，役賦轉重，獄犴日結，百姓困擾，甘亂者多，小人愚嶮，共相扇惑。

translations.literal: Recently labor service and taxes have grown heavier, prisons and lawsuits are daily knotted, the common people are distressed and disturbed, and many would gladly accept disorder, while foolish and dangerous petty men fan and delude one another.
translations.idiomatic: Recently labor service and taxes have grown heavier, prisons and lawsuits are daily knotted, the common people are distressed and disturbed, and many would gladly accept disorder, while foolish and dangerous petty men fan and delude one another.

sentences.zh: 雖勢無所至，然不可不虞。

translations.literal: Although their momentum has not reached anywhere, it cannot go unwatched.
translations.idiomatic: Although their momentum has not reached anywhere, it cannot go unwatched.

sentences.zh: 案《洪範傳》，君道虧則日蝕，人憤怨則水湧益，陰氣積則下代上。

translations.literal: According to the Hongfan zhuan, when the ruler's Way is deficient, the sun is eclipsed; when people are angry and resentful, waters surge and increase; when yin qi accumulates, the lower replaces the upper.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Hongfan zhuan, when the ruler's Way is deficient, the sun is eclipsed; when people are angry and resentful, waters surge and increase; when yin qi accumulates, the lower replaces the upper.

sentences.zh: 此微理潛應已著實於事者也。

translations.literal: These subtle principles and hidden responses have already become manifest in actual affairs.
translations.idiomatic: These subtle principles and hidden responses have already become manifest in actual affairs.

sentences.zh: 假令臣遂不幸謬中，必貽陛下側席之憂。

translations.literal: If I should unfortunately prove wrong, it will still leave Your Majesty with the worry of sitting uneasily.
translations.idiomatic: If I should unfortunately prove wrong, it will still leave Your Majesty with the worry of sitting uneasily.

sentences.zh: 今皇孫載育，天固靈基，黔首顒顒，實望惠潤。

translations.literal: Now the imperial grandson has been born, Heaven has secured the numinous foundation, and the black-haired people gaze upward, truly hoping for moistening grace.
translations.idiomatic: Now the imperial grandson has been born, Heaven has secured the numinous foundation, and the black-haired people gaze upward, truly hoping for moistening grace.

sentences.zh: 又歲涉午位，金家所忌。

translations.literal: Moreover the year has entered the wu position, which the Metal house fears.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the year has entered the wu position, which the Metal house fears.

sentences.zh: 宜於此時崇恩布澤，則火氣潛消，災譴不生矣。

translations.literal: At this time You should exalt grace and spread favor, and then fire qi will secretly dissolve and disasters and rebukes will not arise.
translations.idiomatic: At this time You should exalt grace and spread favor, and then fire qi will secretly dissolve and disasters and rebukes will not arise.

sentences.zh: 陛下上承天意，下順物情，可因皇孫之慶大赦天下。

translations.literal: Your Majesty may above receive Heaven's intent and below follow the feelings of things by using the celebration of the imperial grandson to grant a great amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty may above receive Heaven's intent and below follow the feelings of things by using the celebration of the imperial grandson to grant a great amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 然後明罰敕法，以肅理官，克厭天心，慰塞人事，兆庶幸甚，禎祥必臻矣。

translations.literal: Afterward clarify punishments and order the laws, thereby making the legal officials solemn, satisfying Heaven's heart, and comforting human affairs; the multitudes would be deeply fortunate, and auspicious signs would surely arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward clarify punishments and order the laws, thereby making the legal officials solemn, satisfying Heaven's heart, and comforting human affairs; the multitudes would be deeply fortunate, and auspicious signs would surely arrive.

sentences.zh: 臣今所陳，暫而省之，或未允聖旨，久而尋之，終亮臣誠。

translations.literal: What I now state, if examined briefly, may not accord with the sage instruction; but if sought out over time, it will finally make clear my sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: What I now state, if examined briefly, may not accord with the sage instruction; but if sought out over time, it will finally make clear my sincerity.

sentences.zh: 若所啟上合，願陛下勿以臣身廢臣之言。

translations.literal: If what I have submitted accords with what is above, I beg Your Majesty not to discard my words because of my person.
translations.idiomatic: If what I have submitted accords with what is above, I beg Your Majesty not to discard my words because of my person.

sentences.zh: 臣言無隱，而陛下納之，適所以顯君明臣直之義耳。

translations.literal: That my words hide nothing and Your Majesty accepts them is precisely what displays the meaning of an enlightened ruler and a direct minister.
translations.idiomatic: That my words hide nothing and Your Majesty accepts them is precisely what displays the meaning of an enlightened ruler and a direct minister.

sentences.zh: 疏奏，納焉，即大赦改年。

translations.literal: Memorial presented—accepted—then great amnesty changed era.
translations.idiomatic: The throne accepted it, proclaimed an amnesty, and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 時暨陽人任穀因耕息於樹下，忽有一人著羽衣就淫之，既而不知所在，穀遂有娠。

translations.literal: At time Jiyang man Ren Gu because ploughed rested beneath tree—suddenly one man wearing feather robe approached violated him—afterward knew not whereabouts—Gu then had pregnancy.
translations.idiomatic: A Jiyang farmer named Ren Gu napped beneath a tree where a feather-robed stranger violated him and vanished; Ren Gu conceived.

sentences.zh: 積月將產，羽衣人復來，以刀穿其陰下，出一蛇子便去。

translations.literal: Months piled about birth—feather-robed man again came—with knife pierced his genitals below—issued one snake child then left.
translations.idiomatic: Months later as labour began the stranger returned, slit his groin, drew out a serpentling, and vanished.

sentences.zh: 谷遂成宦者。

translations.literal: Gu then became eunuch.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Gu became a eunuch thereafter.

sentences.zh: 後詣闕上書，自雲有道術。

translations.literal: Later went palace gate memorialized—self claimed possessed Dao arts.
translations.idiomatic: Later he petitioned court boasting arcane arts.

sentences.zh: 帝留谷于宮中。

translations.literal: Emperor detained Gu within palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor housed Ren Gu inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 璞復上疏曰：「任穀所為妖異，無有因由。

translations.literal: Pu again memorialized saying: Ren Gu acts demon-anomaly—none cause origin.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu wrote again: "Ren Gu's marvel lacks rational cause.

sentences.zh: 陛下玄鑒廣覽，欲知其情狀，引之禁內，供給安處。

translations.literal: Your Majesty dark mirror broad survey—wishes know its circumstance—led within forbidden interior—supply peaceful lodging.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty wished to study him and lodged him within the palace.

sentences.zh: 臣聞為國以禮正，不聞以奇邪。

translations.literal: Your servant hears ruling state by ritual rectitude—not hears by freakish wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: States stand on ritual rectitude, not occult strangeness.

sentences.zh: 所聽惟人，故神降之吉。

translations.literal: What heard only humans—therefore spirits descend auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: Listen to men and spirits grant blessing.

sentences.zh: 陛下簡默居正，動遵典刑。

translations.literal: Your Majesty quiet silent dwell correct—actions follow canonical models.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty rules in austere silence and follows statute.

sentences.zh: 案《周禮》，奇服怪人不入宮，況穀妖詭怪人之甚者，而登講肆之堂，密邇殿省之側，塵點日月，穢亂天聽，臣之私情竊所以不取也。

translations.literal: According Zhou Ritual—strange clothes freakish men do not enter palace—how much more Gu demon deceit freakish man extreme ones—yet ascend lecture mart hall—close beside palace bureau flank—dust spots sun moon—filth confusion heaven hearing—your servant private feeling privately therefore not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou rituals bar freakish dress and persons from palace gates—Ren Gu exceeds every freak yet lectures beside your halls; he soils daylight and befouls imperial ears—I cannot endorse him.

sentences.zh: 陛下若以谷信為神靈所憑者，則應敬而遠之。

translations.literal: Your Majesty if take Gu trust as spirits spirits rely—then ought respect yet distant.
translations.idiomatic: If you deem him spirit-possessed honour him from afar.

sentences.zh: 夫神，聰明正直，接以人事。

translations.literal: As for spirits—bright intelligent upright straight—receive with human affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits are lucid and upright and approach through human affairs.

sentences.zh: 若以穀為妖蠱詐妄者，則當投畀裔土，不宜令褻近紫闈。

translations.literal: If take Gu as demon gu deceit false—then ought cast deliver wild lands—not fit allow irreverent near purple gate.
translations.idiomatic: If he is fraud banish him beyond the frontier—never seat him beside the purple gates.

sentences.zh: 若以穀或是神祇告譴、為國作眚者，則當克己修禮以弭其妖，不宜令谷安然自容，肆其邪變也。

translations.literal: If take Gu perhaps spirits announce reproach—for state make calamity—then ought restrain self cultivate ritual to end its demon—not fit allow Gu peaceful self tolerate—unleash its wicked transformation.
translations.idiomatic: If spirits warn through him discipline yourself with ritual to end the omen—do not let Ren Gu lounge here spreading corruption.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為陰陽陶烝，變化萬端，亦是狐狸魍魎憑假作慝。

translations.literal: Your servant foolishly thinks yin-yang pottery steam—transformations myriad ends—also are foxes wang-liang rely borrow commit evil.
translations.idiomatic: This foolish minister believes yin-yang ferments myriad shapes—often fox-spirits borrow flesh to work harm.

sentences.zh: 願陛下采臣愚懷，特遣穀出。

translations.literal: Wish Your Majesty adopt servant foolish heart—especially dispatch Gu leave.
translations.idiomatic: May Your Majesty heed this plea and send Ren Gu away from court.

sentences.zh: 臣以人乏，忝荷史任，敢忘直筆，惟義是規。」

translations.literal: Because men are lacking, I have unworthily borne the historian's charge; how could I dare forget the straight brush? I regulate myself only by righteousness."
translations.idiomatic: Because men are lacking, I have unworthily borne the historian's charge; how could I dare forget the straight brush? I regulate myself only by righteousness."

sentences.zh: 其後元帝崩，穀因亡走。

translations.literal: Afterward Yuan Emperor died—Gu therefore fled.
translations.idiomatic: After Yuan Emperor died Ren Gu fled.

sentences.zh: 璞以母憂去職，卜葬地于暨陽，去水百步許。

translations.literal: Pu because mother's mourning left office—divined burial land at Jiyang—away water hundred paces about.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning his mother Guo Pu quit office and chose a gravesite at Jiyang within a hundred paces of the river.

sentences.zh: 人以近水為言，璞曰：「當即為陸矣。」

translations.literal: People objected that it was close to the water, but Guo Pu said: "It will soon become land."
translations.idiomatic: People objected that it was close to the water, but Guo Pu said: "It will soon become land."

sentences.zh: 其後沙漲，去墓數十里皆為桑田。

translations.literal: Afterward sand rose—away tomb several tens li all became mulberry fields.
translations.idiomatic: Later silt piled until mulberry orchards stretched tens of li beyond the tomb.

sentences.zh: 未期，王敦起璞為記室參軍。

translations.literal: Before deadline—Wang Dun raised Pu as secretary aide.
translations.idiomatic: Before the period elapsed Wang Dun summoned him as secretary of headquarters.

sentences.zh: 是時潁川陳述為大將軍掾，有美名，為敦所重，未幾而沒。

translations.literal: At time Yingchuan Chen Shu was grand general aide—had fair fame—prized by Dun—not long then died.
translations.idiomatic: Yingchuan's Chen Shu served Wang Dun as aide-in-chief with shining reputation but died soon after.

sentences.zh: 璞哭之哀甚，呼曰：「嗣祖，嗣祖，焉知非福！」

translations.literal: Guo Pu wept over him with great sorrow and called out: "Sizu, Sizu, how do you know this is not fortune?"
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu wept over him with great sorrow and called out: "Sizu, Sizu, how do you know this is not fortune?"

sentences.zh: 夫幾而敦作難。

translations.literal: Not long then Dun raised rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wang Dun rebelled.

sentences.zh: 時明帝即位逾年，未改號，而熒惑守房。

translations.literal: At time Ming Emperor ascended past year—had not changed era—yet Mars lodged in Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Emperor had reigned a year without changing the era name while Mars stalled in the Chamber mansion.

sentences.zh: 璞時休歸，帝乃遣使齎手詔問璞。

translations.literal: Pu at time rested returned—Emperor then dispatched envoy bear handwritten edict ask Pu.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu was home on leave when couriers arrived with the emperor's handwritten questions.

sentences.zh: 會暨陽縣復上言曰赤烏見。

translations.literal: Happened Jiyang county again upward spoke saying red crow appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Jiyang county reported crimson crows.

sentences.zh: 璞乃上疏請改年肆赦，文多不載。

translations.literal: Pu then upward memorial begged change era grant amnesty—text much not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Pu memorialized for a new era name and blanket amnesty—the full text is omitted here.
